听.title: Can apps teach you a language? (6 Minute English)
听.body: Have you ever used Duolingo, Babbel, Busuu or perhaps another language-learning app? How did you get on? Some people love the convenience of these apps - you can learn on the go, like during your commute to work, rather than committing to a certain time each week, like learning in a class. But are they teaching the languages effectively? Neil and Pippa discuss this and teach you some new vocabulary.
听.zh: 你用过 Duolingo、Babbel、Busuu 或其他语言学习 App 吗？体验如何？有人喜欢这类 App 的便捷——通勤路上随时学，不用像上课那样固定时间；但它们真的能高效地教会一门语言吗？Neil 和 Pippa 就此展开讨论，并教你一些新词汇。

说.title: Speaking Practice · AI as your shopping advisor
说.body: Talk for 1-2 minutes: 'Would you trust an AI to help you decide what to buy? Give one example where it could help and one where you'd prefer a human's advice.' Try to use: rely on, trade-off, peace of mind.
说.zh: 用 1-2 分钟口语表达：'你会信任 AI 帮你做购物决策吗？举一个它能帮上忙的例子，以及一个你更想要人类建议的例子。' 尽量用到：rely on, trade-off, peace of mind。

读.title: AI becomes a new gateway to consumer decisions
读.body: Nearly one in four Chinese users of artificial intelligence now turn to the technology for purchase decisions, making AI an emerging gateway for brands, according to a report released by market research company CTR. Among AI users, 24.8 percent have used it to support consumption decisions and 14.5 percent to choose brands or shopping channels. 'The arrival of AI has truly turned the phone into an intelligent assistant,' Wang Jun, director of CTR's mobile user index research, said.
读.zh: 市场研究公司 CTR 报告显示，近四分之一的中国 AI 用户已借助该技术做购买决策，AI 正成为品牌的新入口。在 AI 用户中，24.8% 用它辅助消费决策，14.5% 用它选择品牌或购物渠道。CTR 移动用户指数研究总监王俊表示：'AI 的到来真正把手机变成了智能助手。'

写.title: Writing Task · A brand Playbook for the AI era
写.body: Write 120-150 words: 'Your favourite brand just launched an "AI shopping assistant". Write a short social-media post (for consumers) explaining what it does and why it's useful - without sounding like a hard sell.'
写.zh: 写 120-150 词：'你最喜欢的品牌刚上线了一个"AI 购物助手"。写一条面向消费者的社媒短文，说明它能做什么、为何有用——但不要太像硬广。'

练.title: Vocabulary & Grammar · 'gateway' & 'rather than'
练.body: 1) Vocabulary: Use 'gateway' in a sentence about technology and consumer behaviour. 2) Grammar: Rewrite using 'rather than' - 'Consumers used to browse many apps. Now they ask one AI first.'
练.zh: 1) 词汇：用 gateway 造一个关于科技与消费行为的句子。2) 语法：用 rather than 改写——'消费者过去会逛很多 App，现在先问一个 AI。'
